title: Wire gdstrict-cli to real formatter once gdstrict_format::format lands
body: gdstrict-format exposes no source-level format(&str)->String yet (only the doc IR + renderer in gdstrict_format::doc). gdstrict-cli currently formats via an isolated placeholder seam in crates/gdstrict-cli/src/format.rs that only normalizes line endings, strips trailing whitespace, and enforces a single trailing newline. Swap in gdstrict_format::format() there (one-line change) when the CST->Doc lowering is published, then strengthen the integration tests in crates/gdstrict-cli/tests/cli.rs to assert real reformatting (indentation, wrapping) rather than just whitespace.

title: gdstrict-cli ignore rules are minimal (hidden dirs + target only)
body: crates/gdstrict-cli/src/walk.rs hardcodes a simple ignore: skip entries whose name starts with '.' and any directory named 'target'. No .gitignore / .gdstrictignore integration. Acceptable for Phase 1 per the task spec, but a real ignore layer (e.g. the `ignore` crate) should replace walk::is_ignored before broad use.
